description: Get the authenticated Fitbit user profile. Requires profile scope.

explicit_user_intent.description: Required true when privacy_mode=raw or include_gps=true (agent escalation of redaction).

privacy_mode.description: Optional per-call privacy override. Defaults to FITBIT_PRIVACY_MODE or structured. raw returns upstream Fitbit JSON. summary removes GPS/map details.

name: fitbit_get_profile
title: Get Fitbit Profile
